text_block_list.text:
Unable to overtake Narita Brian, Mayano 
Top Gun suffered a defeat.

Seeing her walk away with a cool, 
nonchalant face, Mayano Top Gun fired up, 
refusing to stay defeated.

In order to defeat Narita Brian, Mayano 
Top Gun set her next goal on the "Tenno 
Sho (Spring)", just like her rival.
